description: This file contains the implementation of the PsmSysRegistry object, including creation, initialization, object enrollment, and removal functions. It defines the core behavior and memory management for the Persistent Storage Manager's system registry component in a platform-independent environment.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmSysroCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new PsmSysRegistry object, allocates memory, and initializes the object's function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the PsmSysRegistry object, freeing associated resources and memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls and initializes required sub-objects and interfaces such as configuration interface, file loader, system RAM interface, info repository, and timers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the PsmSysRegistry object, setting default property values and preparing it for operation.
